versions.changelog:
daily-learning-cards v1.1.0

- 新增首次运行配置向导，自动提问并生成 config.json，降低上手门槛
- 完善多渠道支持：飞书、WebUI、钉钉、微信、QQ 自动识别与合并
- 支持每日学习卡片、每周周报与每周测试自动串联，形成学习闭环
- 开放高度可配置项，包括提取规则、自定义数量与输出格式
- 增强故障排查指南，方便定位提取与定时推送问题
- 丰富文档，详细阐述架构设计、配置说明与高级用法

daily-learning-cards v1.1.0 introduces a structured, automated learning card system for OpenClaw users.

- Automatically extracts knowledge from daily multi-channel AI conversations and generates structured learning cards.
- Adds weekly summary and weekly test features, forming a "capture → consolidate → verify" learning loop.
- Provides a user-friendly configuration wizard and supports multi-channel source detection & delivery.
- Highly configurable: supports custom extraction rules, output limits, scheduling, and delivery targets.
- Enhanced troubleshooting guidance and clarity on supported workflows for OpenClaw users.
